items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...he used to have Raymond Hickey and his sons played with him then, too. [INTERVIEWEE] That's where I, that's where I had the most of my rehearsals.

ctx.x: Yes. Oh, yeah. All around the neighborhood. Your home. All around the neighborhood, yeah.
When, we lived on Charton, Mandeville, is when he used to have Raymond Hickey and his sons played with him then, too.
That's where I, that's where I had the most of my rehearsals.
